about.title: About the project
about.body1: The RETEX project, no. {number}, set out to develop a digital and technological solution for the circular economy in the textile sector, bringing together tools that support collection, sorting, traceability, monitoring and data analysis.
about.body2: The project made it possible to develop and test technological components designed to support door-to-door collection management, the sorting of textile products and the provision of environmental and operational indicators, contributing to greater efficiency and transparency across the circular fashion value chain.

businesses.title: Circularity Credits and ESG reporting
businesses.description: We collect and recover your company's textiles: uniforms, surplus stock, production waste. Every kilo earns credits to offset emissions.

municipalities.title: Less textile in landfill, backed by data
municipalities.description: Door-to-door separate collection for municipalities, with landfill-diversion reports and recycling rates per parish.

howItWorks.title: How it works

steps.title: Create your account
steps.description: Name, email, address. Only what we need to pick it up.

steps.title: Book the pickup
steps.description: Tell us the place, the number of bags and a time slot that suits you.

steps.title: We take care of the rest
steps.description: You're notified when the driver sets off and when your items reach the warehouse.

howItWorks.caption: An item that gets worn again saves the water, land and energy needed to make a new one.

journey.title: What happens to the clothes we collect
journey.description: Every bag is sorted in our warehouse. Each item goes where it has the most value.
photoAlt: Bales of textiles sorted by colour

whyItMatters.title: Over 200,000 tonnes of textiles end up in the bin in Portugal every year.
whyItMatters.description: Every item that circulates again means less raw material taken from nature and less waste in landfill.
